newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill seven people near Pakistani town.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill seven people near Pakistani town.

text.p: Gunmen killed at least seven people, including two policemen, near the town of Larkana in southern Pakistan on Tuesday, ambulance workers said.

Ambulance volunteers of the private Edhi Welfare Trust said unidentified gunmen had ambushed a police vehicle at a railway crossing at Ghanti Gate near Larkana in Sindh province at about 8 a.m. (0300 GMT).
"The bodies of the dead have been removed to Larkana Civil Hospital," Maulana Sattar Edhi, head of the trust, told Reuters.
A police spokesman in Karachi said he had no information about the incident.
There was no immediate word on the motive for the shooting.
